subject.title: feat(channels): add pre-auth access requests and grouped DM allowlists

question: Should OpenClaw accept a content-bearing pre-auth hook with automatic trusted-handler activation, or require explicit activation and minimal metadata while reusing the canonical accessGroups contract?
rationale: Implementation evidence cannot decide the permanent public plugin API, pre-admission privacy boundary, upgrade activation behavior, or whether a second sender-group storage model is acceptable.

options.title: Refactor To Canonical Groups
options.body: Retain the workflow but use accessGroups references, require explicit activation, and expose message content only through a deliberate opt-in contract.

options.title: Approve The New Contracts
options.body: Accept fixed grouped allowlist objects and automatic trusted-hook activation as supported contracts with explicit compatibility and security documentation.

options.title: Split Or Pause
options.body: Separate the generic pre-auth hook from grouping and access-request automation, or pause the broad proposal until each direction is sponsored.

recommendation.title: Refactor To Canonical Groups
recommendation.body: Retain the workflow but use accessGroups references, require explicit activation, and expose message content only through a deliberate opt-in contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The available feature history most strongly connects this person to the shared ingress, allowlist, config-mutation, and plugin SDK decision surface.
